notes:
REF-BM-03: Collected title and description can be edited only after the initial save.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate saves are prevented and the existing card is highlighted, but the user is not taken into editing it.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk-action implementation exists.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the complete currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving is unavailable.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved-filter bundle entity or workflow exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: Default sorting is adjustable, but displayed-item and font-size settings are absent.
